app_subtitle: Unofficial PC port of the PlayStation 3 version (BLES00028)
play_ready_detail: Built on this PC from your own disc.
play_notready_detail: {0} steps left. Setup finishes them for you.
play_disclaimer: Nothing from the game comes with this launcher. The game is translated and built on your PC from your own copy.
setup_subtitle: Everything the build needs. Set up everything does it in order, and asks before it installs or downloads anything.
detail_crt: 630 MB from Microsoft (xwin); not needed with Visual Studio
detail_memory_low: 8 GB or more is needed to build
detail_disc: Your own copy, as an image or a folder
detail_ffmpeg_missing: Download it, or choose a folder
detail_built: Translated and built on this PC
gfx_subtitle: How the picture reaches your screen. Changes apply the next time the game starts.
gfx_vsync_desc: Wait for the display, so the picture does not tear.
gfx_async_desc: No pause the first time a scene appears. Some objects can show up a few frames late instead.
gfx_res_desc: The size the game draws its picture at. Higher is sharper and asks more of the graphics card. Automatic matches your window.
gfx_scaler_desc: How the game's picture is scaled to your window.
gfx_sharpen_desc: Adaptive: strong on soft detail, gentle on edges.
gfx_aa_desc: Smooths jagged edges. It uses smooth scaling.
gfx_aniso_desc: Sharper floors and roads seen at a slant.
settings_game_language_desc: Voices, subtitles and menus. The disc carries these six.
settings_keyboard_desc: A controller always works: Xbox, and with SDL2 PlayStation and Switch too. Without one, the keys below play.
settings_esc_desc: Off: Esc does nothing, so pausing never closes the game by mistake.
support_update_desc: Pulls the latest version of the project and builds the game again. The build is redone in full.
support_report_desc: A zip on your desktop with your PC's specs, the setup status and the last game logs. No game files, and your Windows user folder is hidden.
support_about_text: Soleanna (sonic06-recomp) is an unofficial, fan-made port, not affiliated with or endorsed by SEGA. Its code is under the MIT license. The game belongs to SEGA, and the tools the launcher downloads keep their own licenses.
dlg_folder: The folder of your BLES00028 disc (the one holding PS3_GAME)
dlg_ffmpeg: An FFmpeg 8 shared build: the folder holding bin and include
plan_build: download ps3recomp, translate the game code and build it ({0} files at a time)
msg_allset: Everything is set up. Press Play.
msg_not_ffmpeg8: That folder has no bin\avcodec-62.dll: it is not FFmpeg 8.
gfx_adapter_desc: Which card draws the game. Automatic picks the fastest.
settings_deadzone_desc: How far the stick must move before it counts. Raise it if the character drifts.
settings_screenshot: F12 saves a screenshot to Pictures\Sonic06 while the game window is in front.
detail_sdl2: For PlayStation and Switch controllers. Without it, Xbox-style controllers still work.
plan_sdl2: download SDL2 (zlib license), for PlayStation and Switch controllers, and build the game again
keys_desc: Used when no controller is connected. Click a key to change it, then press the new key or a mouse button. Esc keeps the old one, Backspace clears it.
keys_mouse_desc: The mouse becomes the right stick. While the game window is in front, the cursor is hidden and stays inside it.
